two-top/311bc8f:
GET /ice was unauthenticated and unthrottled; anyone who pulls
TWOTOP_ICE_URL out of the public APK can farm throwaway TURN
credentials in a loop, and each Cloudflare credential is billable
relay capacity minted on this project's key. The 4-hour TTL bounds one
credential's life, not the farming rate.

Two raises. A per-IP token bucket (capacity 5, one refill per 30 s;
keyed by first X-Forwarded-For hop behind Railway's edge, socket
address otherwise) answers 429 past the burst, and a sweep drops
idle entries past 10k tracked addresses so cycling source IPs rents
memory instead of keeping it. An optional ICE_APP_KEY turns /ice into
a turnstile: the APK bakes TWOTOP_ICE_KEY and sends X-App-Key, and a
bare scrape gets 403. The key is extractable from the APK like any
baked string, so it filters drive-by scrapers rather than
authenticating anyone. /healthz stays exempt from both, so Railway's
healthcheck can never be throttled into a restart loop.

Verified live: a burst of 8 returns 5x200 then 3x429 with /healthz at
200 throughout; keyed mode returns 403/403/200 for bare/wrong/right
and /healthz 200.
two-top/3142d3b:
Ground shadows, charge auras, and aim telegraphs now scale by their
owner's table depth, so the perspective read stays coherent: a
far-court body no longer sits under a full-size shadow or out-shone by
a full-size aura. Each derives the scale from its owner's PositionF
through the PerspectiveFlip, matching how the actor sprites already
scale.

A taunt wears the charge aura inverted: the ring swells outward and
heats from bone to spark over the flex, so the gamble is as public as
a wind-up. The dark-beyond eyes are brighter (they read as dead pixels
at arm's length otherwise) and the menu scrim is darker so the center
sigil stops ghosting through the title copy.
perennials/31355f0:
"Not in our sources" is the honest sentence and it still leaves her holding
a flower she can identify. The honesty rule says we don't invent a value to
fill a gap; it never said she couldn't. She is standing in front of the
plant, which is a better instrument than anything we scraped.

So a blank row now offers a "+", and only a blank one: a field the sources
filled is not hers to overwrite and never shows the affordance. Her value
renders in the sepia her notes and bloom marks already use, so it cannot be
read as a scraped one. Functions is the one row where hers sits beside
values we do have, because a plant can do something in her yard that no
contributor wrote down; that is an addition, not a correction. The section
used to vanish entirely when the sources had nothing, which is exactly the
case where a permaculture gardener most obviously knows better.

Photos go to IndexedDB, not localStorage. A phone camera writes 2-4MB and
the origin gets about 5MB of localStorage; one snap would blow the budget
and take her notes, kept list and yard plans down with it, because
localStorage fails the write when it is full and the caller cannot make
room. They downscale to 1400px on the long edge (~200KB) through
createImageBitmap with imageOrientation, or a portrait snap lands sideways
with no way to fix it.

No bloomPeriod field. She already has a bloom record and it is a better
one: seen.ts stamps real dates in her yard, where a typed "Late Spring"
would only be her copying USDA's guess back at us.

Carries this page's share of the absence rewording, which is the same
change seen from the other side: the blank says less and now offers more.
